failures.tests: No test fails: tests/sim/playthrough-starters.test.ts (about 62 s of synchronous simulation on a 4-core cloud container) makes Vitest report an unhandled 'Timeout calling "onTaskUpdate"' error, so `npm test` exits 1 with every test passing.
evidence: Cloud session 2026-10-05, HEAD 94eae78: npm test → Test Files 161 passed, Tests 1792 passed, Errors 5 ('[vitest-worker]: Timeout calling "onTaskUpdate"'), exit 1 (an earlier run under load: 3 errors).
npx vitest run tests/sim/playthrough-starters.test.ts alone → 6 passed in 62.5 s, 1 unhandled error, exit 1.
The same command at 0d9fc5a (temporary worktree, same node_modules) → 6 passed in 62.9 s, 1 unhandled error, exit 1: present at the baseline.
With an afterEach that awaits setImmediate (throwaway config) → 6 passed in 61.8 s, no error, exit 0.
Vitest 3.2.7: the worker's RPC timeout is DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = 6e4 (node_modules/vitest/dist/chunks/index.B521nVV-.js) and the runner advances between tests on microtasks only.
failures.classification: ENVIRONMENT (machine speed and load); the owner's Mac passed the baseline unit gate (151 files, 1,753 tests, exit 0).
failures.detail: The 60 s RPC reply timer fires before the worker's event loop can read the reply when a file runs more than 60 s of synchronous tests back to back. Slower or busier machines cross that line.
failures.nextStep: Fixed by ADR-0010: tests/sim/setup/yield-between-tests.ts registered in vitest.config.ts setupFiles. The unit gate is re-run on the S0 tree with verify-slice.mjs.
